あらすじ

Maejima Yukio the protagonist is a sophomore student at a private academy. He has a girlfriend Kashiba Miyu, she is introverted and does not talk much about herself or her family.

However she and Yukio have been going out for a while and their relationship has deepened, that is when Miyu decides to invite Yukio to her house. There Yukio meets Miyu’s sister Kaori and her strict mother Kimie…he soon develops a relationship with them too…

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2009-12-25

  • 日本語名: NACHTMUSIK ZERO ～女衒に心身を捧ぐ二律背反のメイド～
  • 英語名: Nachtmusik Zero Jogen ni Shinshin o Sasagu Niritsu Haihan no Maid

あらすじ

The night before Alec inherits the title of fourth-generation royal court ’trainer’, he and his attendant Millie brace for their final test.

Now they must prove their skills—on each other.

They’ve trained side by side since childhood, but this? This makes their skin prickle with something sharper than nerves.
